mapper.select: SELECT CODE AS "code", CODE_NM AS "codeNm", CODE_DC AS "codeDc" FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE WHERE CODE_ID = #{codeId} AND USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY CODE_DC, CODE
SELECT ORGNZT_ID AS "orgnztId", ORGNZT_NM AS "orgnztNm" FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO ORDER BY ORGNZT_NM
SELECT COURT_ID AS "courtId", COURT_NM AS "courtNm" FROM LAW_COURT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND COURT_ID > 0 ORDER BY SORT_ORDR, COURT_ID
SELECT LAWYER_ID AS "lawyerId", LAW_FIRM || ' / ' || LAWYER_NM AS "label" FROM LAW_LAWYER WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY LAW_FIRM, LAWYER_NM, LAWYER_ID
